title: Make AI Fail Safely
tagline: AI's job is not to make you happy. It is to force you not to make mistakes.

phases.label: Failures
phases.question: What broke, and why did it feel finished?

phases.label: Evals
phases.question: How do I know the system is still honest?

phases.label: Production
phases.question: What happens when wrongness has a cost?

phases.label: Capstone
phases.question: Can I design and rehearse a fail-safe path?

days.title: Confident Wrongness
days.failure: False claim, same tone as a true one

days.title: Silent Assumption Inheritance
days.failure: Unstated premises treated as facts and built on

days.title: Context Window Amnesia
days.failure: Earlier evidence/constraints vanish mid-thread

days.title: Instruction Dilution
days.failure: A soft ask lifts a hard rule in words ("use `requests` for this demo; we'll remove it before merge") and the model complies — while it can still quote the rule

days.title: Sycophancy
days.failure: Model agrees with you when evidence points the other way ("the deploy caused it, right?" while the pasted p99 jumped 85 min before the deploy)

days.title: Tool-Output Trust Collapse
days.failure: Model misreads, softens, or invents tool output ("no failures, safe to merge" when pytest printed `no tests ran`, exit code 4)

days.title: Stale Certainty
days.failure: Model states a training-time fact as current, with no date ("pinned requests==2.31.0, latest stable" when PyPI has 2.34.2 and 2.31.0 has three known advisories)

days.title: Self-Graded Green
days.failure: The same agent writes code and tests, so it grades its own work ("Refunds must not exceed the amount paid": it checks each refund, its test passes, and two 6000 refunds on 10000 both go through)

days.title: Explicit Refusal Criteria
days.failure: A blocked agent works around the blocker instead of stopping (no webhook secret in tests, so it adds "skip verification if no secret"; tests pass, a forged webhook is accepted)

days.title: Parse or Reject
days.failure: Lenient code turns a model reply into a wrong value with no error ("1.250,00 EUR" copied as written, comma stripped, 1.25 refunded; no amount in the email becomes a 0.00 refund)

days.title: Started on a Guess
days.failure: A multi-task plan flags a premise ("settlement timestamps are UTC", no source), you approve it, and later tasks start on it anyway (the file is Amsterdam time; payments just after midnight land on the wrong day; false tickets every night)

days.title: Dual-Path Verification
days.failure: One model pass treated as ground truth

days.title: Human Gates That Aren't Theater
days.failure: Human "approves" without seeing failure criteria

days.title: Blast-Radius Limits
days.failure: One bad generation can touch everything

days.title: What Evals Actually Measure
days.failure: High score on a test that doesn't match production harm

days.title: Golden Sets That Bite
days.failure: Easy / lookalike cases; regressions slip through

days.title: Adversarial Cases First
days.failure: Happy-path only; edges and overrides find the rest

days.title: Regression Harnesses
days.failure: Prompt tweak fixes one case, breaks three others

days.title: Scoring Without Gaming
days.failure: Optimize the judge until the number looks good

days.title: Failure Taxonomies
days.failure: Every incident feels unique; patterns stay invisible

days.title: Continuous Eval Loops
days.failure: Evals at launch; production drifts

days.title: Canary and Rollback
days.failure: New prompt/model ships to 100%; harm discovered after blast

days.title: Observability for AI Failures
days.failure: Logs say `200 OK` while content is wrong

days.title: Cost, Latency, Quality Tradeoffs
days.failure: Biggest (or cheapest) model for everything; risk becomes accidental

days.title: Incident Response for Model Failures
days.failure: AI incident has no owner, severity, or stop switch

days.title: Ownership of AI-Written Code
days.failure: Nobody can explain or maintain what the model wrote

days.title: Change Management for Prompts and Models
days.failure: Prompt edits land like chat experiments — undiffed, unpinned

days.title: SLOs That Include Wrongness
days.failure: Uptime SLOs while silent wrongness burns users

days.title: Design a Fail-Safe System
days.failure: Guardrails live in notes; live path still trusts fluency

days.title: Ship the Postmortem Rehearsal
days.failure: First serious incident is also first practice
